# Agent system instructions

This repository has a tool-neutral agent system in `docs/agent-system/`.

Use it when working on:

- GAP Discovery, Implementation or Audit
- Code audits
- UI/mobile audits
- Mobile UI workflows
- Idea parking or promotion
- Project memory / system learner updates

Read:

- `AGENTS.md`
- `docs/agent-system/README.md`
- `docs/agent-system/commands/README.md`
- Relevant workflow and rule files in `docs/agent-system/`

Do not modify `.claude/**` by default.

Allowed exceptions:

- GAP workflow may update `.claude/gaps/**`.
- Ideas workflow may update `.claude/ideas/parking-lot.md`.

Do not migrate Claude Code files unless Jose explicitly asks.

If generic AI or shadcn guidance conflicts with La PesquerApp docs, follow
La PesquerApp docs.
